mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDPC1 indicates strong economic demand, which positively impacts corporate earnings and thus drives up S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in UNRATE suggests labor market tightening, potentially leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both UNRATE and FEDFUNDS increase, it signals tightening monetary policy, leading to decreased borrowing and investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE and FEDFUNDS rise but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in INDPRO growth indicates potential supply chain issues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth slows but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing HOUST suggests strong housing demand, boosting related sectors and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RSAFS indicates reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPIAUCSL combined with higher FEDFUNDS indicates inflationary pressures and tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in FEDFUNDS during a monetary easing cycle reduces borrowing costs, stimulating investment and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS declines but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.
